parameters.name: DnsRecord
parameters.description: Rewrite the DNS resolution record for the origin request.

parameters.name: Follow302Enable
parameters.description:
302 redirection toggle for origin fetch. Valid values:
- on: Enabled.
- off: Disabled.

parameters.name: Follow302MaxTries
parameters.description: Maximum number of 302 redirect attempts. Valid values: [1–5].

parameters.name: Follow302RetainArgs
parameters.description:
Toggle to retain original request parameters. Valid values:
- on: Enabled.
- off: Disabled.

parameters.name: Follow302RetainHeader
parameters.description:
Toggle to retain original request headers. Valid values:
- on: Enabled.
- off: Disabled.

parameters.name: Follow302TargetHost
parameters.description: Modify the origin host after a 302 redirect.

parameters.name: OriginHost
parameters.description: The HOST carried in the origin request.

parameters.name: OriginHttpPort
parameters.description: Port of the origin server when using the HTTP protocol for origin requests.

parameters.name: OriginHttpsPort
parameters.description: Port of the origin server when using the HTTPS protocol for origin requests.

parameters.name: OriginMtls
parameters.description:
mTLS switch. Possible values:
- on: Enable.
- off: Disable.

parameters.name: OriginReadTimeout
parameters.description: Origin read timeout (seconds).

parameters.name: OriginScheme
parameters.description:
Protocol used for the origin request. Possible values:
- http: Use HTTP protocol for origin requests.
- https: Use HTTPS protocol for origin requests.
- follow: Follow the client's protocol for origin requests.

parameters.name: OriginSni
parameters.description: SNI carried in the origin request.

parameters.name: OriginVerify
parameters.description:
Origin certificate verification switch. Possible values:
- on: Enable.
- off: Disable.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description:
Use range chunking for origin downloads. Possible values:
- on: Enable
- off: Disable
- force: Force

parameters.name: RangeChunkSize
parameters.description:
Range shard size. Valid values:
- 512 KB
- 1 MB
- 2 MB
- 4 MB

parameters.name: Rule
parameters.description:
Rule content, using conditional expressions to match user requests. This parameter is not required when adding global configurations. There are two usage scenarios:
- Match all incoming requests: Set the value to true
- Match specific requests: Set the value to a custom expression, for example: (http.host eq \"video.example.com\")

parameters.name: RuleEnable
parameters.description:
Rule switch. This parameter is not required when adding global configurations. Possible values:
- on: Enable.
- off: Disable.

parameters.name: RuleName
parameters.description: Rule name. This parameter is not required when adding global configurations.

parameters.name: Sequence
parameters.description: Rule execution order. Rules with smaller numeric values are executed first.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: Site ID, which can be obtained by calling the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) interface.

parameters.name: SiteVersion
parameters.description: Version number of the site configuration. For sites with version management enabled, you can use this parameter to specify the version of the site where the configuration takes effect. The default is version 0.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun esa create-origin-rule --site-id 340035003106221 --site-version 1 --rule-name rule_example --rule-enable on --rule http.host_eq_video.example.com --origin-host origin.example.com --origin-scheme http --origin-sni origin.example.com --dns-record test.example.com --origin-http-port 8080 --origin-https-port 4433 --range on --origin-mtls on --origin-verify on --range-chunk-size 1MB --sequence 1 --origin-read-timeout 10 --follow-302-enable on --follow-302-max-tries 1 --follow-302-retain-args on --follow-302-retain-header on --follow-302-target-host test.com --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun esa CreateOriginRule --region cn-hangzhou --SiteId 340035003106221 --Follow302MaxTries 1 --RuleEnable on --OriginHttpsPort 4433 --Follow302RetainArgs on --OriginScheme http --Sequence 1 --Follow302RetainHeader on --Range on --RangeChunkSize 1MB --OriginReadTimeout 10 --OriginHost 'origin.example.com' --OriginHttpPort 8080 --OriginMtls on --Follow302TargetHost 'test.com' --OriginSni 'origin.example.com' --Rule 'http.host_eq_video.example.com' --DnsRecord 'test.example.com' --Follow302Enable on --SiteVersion 1 --RuleName rule_example --OriginVerify on
